title: USLawEnforcementJurisdictionComparison
description: Standardized schema for comparing statutory authority, geographic boundaries, primary mandates, and inter-agency operational parameters across US law enforcement jurisdictional tiers.

jurisdiction_tiers.description: Comparative matrix covering municipal, county, state, and special jurisdiction tiers.

examples: City Police Department
Town Marshal Office
County Sheriff's Office
County Police Department
State Police
Highway Patrol
State Bureau of Investigation (SBI/DCI)
Transit Police
Port Authority Police
University Campus Police
Conservation/Fish & Wildlife
City Council / City Manager
Board of County Commissioners / Direct Electorate
State Department of Public Safety / State Legislature
Transit Authority Board / University Board of Regents
Municipal General Fund (Sales, Local Property, Utility Taxes)
County Ad Valorem Property Taxes, Dedicated Law Enforcement Levies
State General Fund, Highway Trust Funds, Surcharges
Dedicated District Levies, Rider Fares, University Tuition/Fees, Enterprise Funds
Incorporated municipal city limits and contiguous annexed territory
Entire geographical county, primary jurisdiction in unincorporated areas
Statewide across all counties, highways, state-owned lands, and incorporated cities
Dedicated real property, transit rights-of-way, airport terminals, campus facilities

hot_pursuit_limitations.description: Conditions under which officers may cross jurisdictional lines during active pursuit.

post_certification_required.description: Requires State Peace Officer Standards and Training certification.

local_ordinance_enforcement.description: Authority to enforce municipal codes, zoning codes, and local civil infractions.

civil_process_execution.description: Mandated execution of evictions, subpoenas, writs of execution, and property levies.

examples: Local Part I/II crimes occurring within municipal boundary
Crimes in unincorporated county areas, complex homicide/burglary support for small towns
Multi-county organized crime, public integrity/corruption, state officer-involved shootings
Internal facility crimes, infrastructure sabotage, asset theft, wildlife poaching

court_security_mandate.description: Statutory responsibility for county/state courthouse screening and bailiff operations.

operates_holding_cells.description: Short-term temporary booking or holding facilities (under 72 hours).

operates_county_or_state_jail.description: Long-term pre-trial detention facilities and sentenced county jail populations.

inmate_transport_mandate.description: Statutory transport of inmates between courts, medical facilities, and correctional institutions.

examples: State Emergency Management Mutual Aid Agreement / Local Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)
Countywide Inter-Local Agreement (ILA) and regional SWAT/special response compacts
Statewide Emergency Management Assistance Compact (EMAC) coordinator
Specialized cooperative agreements with host municipal and county agencies
